concepts.name: aurora-wings
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one polished 3D game-character concept image based on the attached Ice Phoenix piggy reference. The image is a DESIGN EXPLORATION, not an implementation screenshot. Preserve the recognizable round piggy body, short four feet, two black eyes, broad pig snout with two recessed nostrils, pig ears, ivory face and ice-blue palette. Denser overlapping feather coat with at least twice the reference feather density, close-set rows with almost no empty gaps, individual broad curved feathers. Keep face readable; don't turn the pig into an actual bird or dragon. No ice particles, no floating snow, no fire, no lightning bolts, no weapons, no text/watermarks. Show whole character in a 3/4 front view on a simple dark blue-gray studio background, high quality stylized Roblox-friendly sculpted forms, dramatic but readable lighting. Rear vault aperture must remain flush/unobstructed below original curled pig tail; preserve access lane to crown coin slot. DIRECTION A: AURORA WINGS. Add two sweeping layered feather wings, half spread in an impressive but compact upward arc; long outer feather tips curved elegantly backward. Dense smaller covert feathers at their roots. Several clear luminous cyan-to-violet bands along feather edges suggest light sweeping outward; main feather surfaces retain rich navy/ice blue contrast. Full flowing phoenix tail fan above the curl, narrow crown crest. Dominant effect is luminous feather choreography, not particles or transparent fog.
